name: Wizard Frontend Boilerplate Pro
description: Scaffold production-ready frontend apps with Next.js, React, Vue, Nuxt, or Svelte with themed component showcase, design tokens, and light/dark theming
long_description:
A comprehensive skill for scaffolding production-ready frontend applications. Features include:

- Support for Next.js, React + Vite, Vue 3, Nuxt 4, and SvelteKit
- 28 pre-built UI components across 6 categories
- Automatic color palette generation with OKLCH algorithm
- Light/dark mode with FOUC prevention
- Tailwind v4 support with @theme directive
- Collapsible code snippets in showcase
- WCAG AA compliant color contrast
- Works with ui-ux-pro-max skill for enhanced UI/UX
features: Framework-specific setup (Next.js, React, Vue, Nuxt, SvelteKit)
Interactive user interview for project configuration
compatibility_notes: Works with any AI agent CLI (Aider, Claude, Claude Code, Codex, Continue, Cursor, Gemini, Gemini CLI, Opencode, Tabby, Windsurf). Uses standard shell commands and file operations. Pairs best with ui-ux-pro-max skill for enhanced UI/UX recommendations.
